preconditions.description: The number of strings is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
Each string consists of lowercase English letters and has a length between 1 and 100, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'YES' or 'NO', indicating whether the strings can be reordered to satisfy the condition.

postconditions.expression: output == 'YES' ==> all(any(string in previous_string for previous_string in strings[:i]) for i, string in enumerate(strings))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', then for every string, all strings that are placed before it are its substrings.

postconditions.expression: output == 'NO' ==> not any(all(any(string in previous_string for previous_string in strings[:i]) for i, string in enumerate(strings)) for string in strings)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'NO', then there exists at least one string that is not a substring of any string that appears before it in the output.
